name: SpQR: A Sparse-Quantized Representation for Near-Lossless LLM Weight Compression (arXiv:2306.03078)
notes: SpQR paper by Dettmers et al. Introduces sparse-quantized representation for near-lossless LLM weight compression at 3-4 bits per parameter. Achieves relative accuracy losses of less than 1% in perplexity for LLaMA and Falcon. Enables 33B parameter LLM on single 24 GB consumer GPU with 15% speedup and 4x memory compression.
